title: Field-arithmetic batch kernels
description:
Batched SIMD kernels for the field-arithmetic modules. Largest research-impact wins in the epic — extension-field tower ops have 3–6 independent base-field muls per element that schedule naturally onto SIMD lanes. ## Children (5 tasks) - **C1** — GF(2^m) batch element-wise mul/square for m∈{8,16,32}. V3 SIMD via VPCLMULQDQ-on-YMM (2 element pairs/instr) + Barrett reduce in YMM → V4 unroll 4-way for ILP. - **C2** — GF(2^m) batch for m=571 (BCH/EC research path). V3 SIMD multi-word VPCLMULQDQ → V4 register tile across the 9 u64 words. Currently scalar multi-word. - **C3** — `Fp

` Montgomery batch for general 64-bit primes (SoA). V3 SIMD via 32×4 limb decomposition on AVX2. Sub-task: AVX-512 IFMA52 path (52-bit unsigned multiply-add) on a Rust-1.89 MSRV branch — only opened if AVX2 path is below 1.5×, and only after explicit user MSRV-bump approval per `escalation-policy.md`. - **C4** — `gfpn::QuadraticExt::mul` Karatsuba batched over a SoA `Vec>`. V2 ILP (3 base-field muls already independent) → V3 SIMD batched. Benchmark target: `field_matrix_fusion.rs`. - **C5** — `gfpn::CubicExt::mul` analogous (6 independent base-field muls). Reuses C4's SoA scaffolding. ## Depends on S0 (all four I-tasks). C4 must complete before C5 (shared SoA scaffolding). ## Success criteria Per-task: per-kernel execution protocol from epic spec doc. C3 IFMA52 sub-task additionally gated on user MSRV approval.
